response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.insurstat AS insurstat, COUNT(DISTINCT c.zoneref) AS site_count FROM scanconservation c JOIN sites s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.insurstat) SELECT insurstat, site_count, site_count * 1.0 / SUM(site_count) OVER () AS share FROM g

assumptions.assumption: Inner join to sites; every conservation record has a matching site (the foreign key guarantees it), so none are dropped. A NULL insurstat forms its own group, which GROUP BY does naturally.
The share denominator is the sum of the per-status distinct site counts. Since each site has exactly one insurance status, this equals the total number of distinct sites with conservation records.
